_week: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (Week 45). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales slipped 4.1% to $4,656 while ad spend rose 11% to $1,193. Orders rose 3.3% to 218. West Coast IPA nearly doubled to $583 and Mexican Cerveza rebounded 42% to $576; Hazy IPA and Cherry Blossom both fell 28% and the Variety 12 Pack fell 11% to $2,251.
refunds: Refunds were $166.01 (6 units) vs $169.58 (6 units) last week. $135.97 (4 units) is the Variety 12 Pack, $18.47 (1 unit) the 19.2oz Tallboy and $11.57 (1 unit) the Hazy IPA.
pacing_reco: At $649 a day, November projects to $19,464, below October's $24,197. Getting closer needs cheaper category ads and the Variety Pack kept in stock into BF/CM.
ads_context: ACoS rose to 76.5% from 61.8% and TACoS to 25.6% from 22.1%.
Spend went up 11% while ad sales fell 10% to $1,561, so each ad dollar returned $1.31 vs $1.62.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $411.45 on $80.45 (19.6% ACoS) for 17 orders.
Category keywords cost $814.21 for $938.77 (86.7% ACoS); remarketing spent $237.80 for $54.71.
